Type: deco
Name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Global Inspired Geometric Throw Blanket, Soft and Stylish, 50" x 60", Navy and Natural
Colors: NAVY/NATURAL
Geometric prints bring a global flair to this eye-catching throw blanket. Neutral colors, fringed edges and super soft, all-cotton texture make it ideal for snuggling in any style bedroom, or for draping across a couch or sofa. 50" x 60" 100% Cotton Dry clean for best results Made in Portugal
